s01044.summary: Orrin and Sable creep into the moth-covered library, bickering quietly
Tamsin collides with the intruders and tells them they should not be here
The moths rise, Orrin draws, and all three tumble into the aisle
Masked Vesper appears, stills the moths and orders the lantern down

s01045.summary: Claudette coaches Leonard through goat yoga while a goat eats his sock
Mama Rose calls on speaker and grills Claudette about the man present
Mama Rose demands she come home; Claudette fends her off lovingly
Beyonce bleats triumphantly and Claudette teases Leonard about it
Claudette hangs up, resettles, and resumes the class with Warrior One

s01046.summary: Prudence waits a long time outside the nap pod with her phone
Malcolm emerges unsurprised; Prudence claims she returned for her coat
Prudence doubts the numbers and says Malcolm rewrote her spreadsheet
Malcolm calmly frames his rewrite as efficiency and streamlining
Prudence folds her coat and decides to stay in her office
At the door Prudence asks if he dreams; he says never
Prudence leaves and Malcolm seals himself back into his pod

s01047.summary: Stranded at the broken stagecoach, the three watch a growing speck
Dutch asks to be unchained to shoot; Cullen refuses flatly
They share water as the speck becomes a lone rider
The rider stops and waves a white cloth; everyone eases

s01048.summary: Dee-Dee hosts the overnight show from a cinderblock studio in the corn
Roland comes in about the hot transmitter and settles with a sandwich
Cal shuffles in and mentions one nameless repeat caller
Dee-Dee takes the call; the caller dedicates a song to the three
The caller says they can see him; a flashlight points from the field
Dee-Dee keeps her voice steady, plays the song; the flashlight dies

s01049.summary: In the storm tent Gloria calls another vote and only she raises
Min-Jun wavers and Deez says he never leaned toward conviction
Deez slams his cup and attacks the evidence against the teenager
Min-Jun steps between them and tries to stop the fight
Deez accuses Gloria of deciding on day one
Gloria slaps down her cards and Deez knocks them to the floor
Both vow not to leave the tent until someone yields
The generator fails and the three sit motionless in darkness

s01050.summary: In her funeral dress, Odalys sits rigid through the car wash
Odalys remembers her husband never washing the car in forty-one years
She rests her forehead on the wheel, laughs, then stops
Odalys puts the car in drive and rolls into the light

s01051.summary: In the cider mill, Juniper presses pulp while family and buyer idle
Juniper announces the last press and promises Oluwaseun his count
Colm hears breathing under the cider; everyone goes still and listens
Juniper and Beata deny a basement; the ground does not like digging
The lantern swings, the bees thicken, Juniper tastes the juice
Juniper sharply orders Colm to put down his harmonica
Beata stops peeling and whispers it is early; Juniper agrees
The breathing quickens and the barrel under Colm bulges outward
Everyone scatters while Juniper grabs a mallet and orders them out
Alone, Juniper raises the mallet and waits at the creaking barrel

s01052.summary: Tamara lies sleepless in the cramped survey capsule
She plays back her identical daily log entry
She takes out a creased photo and puts it back unseen
She replays the identical logs over and over
She presses her palm to the cold porthole and wipes the fog
Recording the next log, she cannot say crew morale is fine

s01053.summary: In the shelter, the wardens log the approaching drone of bombers
Control warns Edmund that flares are falling and incendiaries will follow
Edmund orders helmets on and buckets ready
Vera and Alf question the plan; Edmund snaps that he knows his business
A strike hits the Albert Road: Edmund's shop and daughter's flat
Ordered to stay, Edmund defies Control and goes up with Alf

s01054.summary: A frightened woman locks herself in and checks every corner
She tests a tape recorder and logs day one
She lifts the motel phone, hears a dial tone, sets it back
Playback contains her own voice whispering I'm in the room
She replays the tape and the extra line is gone
A key tag reminds her she is Lena Marsh; she rehearses her identity
The recorder turns on by itself and speaks in her voice
Lena rips out the cassette and smashes it against the TV
She slides to the floor, hugging her knees
The bathroom light and doorknob move on their own; Lena begs
Lena crawls under the bed clutching the cracked cassette
The cassette whispers day two; Lena answers I know; the lamp clicks on

s01055.summary: Philomena stirs Sunday sauce while Artur slices bread and Soledad scrolls
Philomena chides Artur for skipping Sundays
Philomena mocks her late husband's cooking; Artur asks her to stop
Philomena sees through the visit and demands Artur say it
Artur tells his mother the doctor's results say she is sick
Philomena calmly says she already knows what the cough means
Artur says they want her in care; she sees through a little while
Weeping, Philomena seats them and serves Soledad sauce, joking grimly
Philomena reveals the recipe's only ingredient is her decades of Sundays
Soledad eats through tears; Artur holds his mother's hand

s01056.summary: Five thieves gather on the edge of an abandoned carousel
Duchess calls the crew to session amid teasing
Slim lays out four million hidden in the column that doesn't turn
Duchess explains they'll pretend to belong, with fake permits, Pearl driving
Pearl wants a bigger cut; they discuss an equal split
Bones reveals a sixth share in Lavalle's ledger for a stranger
Duchess confronts Lavalle; he coolly admits he told her what she needed

s01057.summary: The night staff of the hospital barge run quiet rounds
The hull groans and the barge shifts; nobody reacts
Mrs. Wray banters with Ismail about the slow, boring night
Linh reads her the cracker box; the staff stifle laughs
Tobias mops on; the horn sounds and Linh jokes about shore leave
Bronwen tucks Mrs. Wray in and assures her everything is fine

s01058.summary: Colter strops a razor while Magdalena reclines under a hot towel
Colter jokes about shaving a woman with no beard
Magdalena steers small talk to the sheriff and his boots on the wall
Colter combs her hair with nervous care, noting she knows his name
Magdalena demands where the sheriff is; Colter evades
Magdalena says the sheriff rode off with her brother and returned alone
Colter backs away pleading ignorance; she calls him a man with an alibi
In the mirror Colter sees boots on the opened threshold
She seats the shaking barber and takes up his razor to talk

s01059.summary: Petra questions Ottoline about signing a survey she never walked
Reginald objects repeatedly as Petra presses about the stump
Clerk Abiodun bursts in with an urgent filing about the ridge
Petra and Reginald both grab for the folder, then pull back
Ottoline reads it and announces the ridge was never theirs

s01060.summary: Under Earthlight, Halcyon and Teodoro banter about kale lunch
Chioma reports a yield drop; Halcyon wryly dismisses the number
Halcyon draws out Teodoro's worry about pump seven and ignored tickets
Nervous new intern Nadeem joins their table
The crew welcome Nadeem and explain who keeps what alive
Teodoro adopts Nadeem as the listener for his pump stories
Commander Stone welcomes Nadeem dryly and moves on
Nadeem tastes the green stuff and realizes it really is kale
They eat as pumps hum and Earth turns far overhead

s01061.summary: Six vested employees ring a locked chest in a corporate escape room
Gregor spouts team clichés while Priya watches the clock
Todd and Beatrice puzzle over the vague greatest-quarter clue
Gregor scolds Marcus for counting down; Marcus twitches
Delilah reads the code off the whiteboard behind Gregor
The chest opens to a card asking them to complete a survey

s01062.summary: Two strangers wait silently in a stalled bus without its driver
Emery calls out to the bus; Naomi says the driver went to radio
Emery hears tapping; Naomi insists it is just the cold
Patient tapping sounds from the back luggage rack
Emery decides to look; both hesitate in the aisle and speak in unison
A wet noise; a duffel bag unzips itself tooth by tooth
They back to the emergency door as Emery hunts for the lever
Long pale fingers slide out and curl over the rack
Emery opens the door; Naomi shoves her out and they tumble
They crawl away without looking back as a hand taps glass

s01063.summary: Four thieves crouch among the museum's clocks before midnight
The lookout warns of a guard; Bartholomew guides Kenji through the wires
Despina finds the dome's second lock listens to the ticks
Despina listens with a stethoscope and times the lock's click
With the guard near, Seraphina orders go and the dome lifts
Kenji eases the golden sun into a velvet bag
They reseal the dome and press back to the wall
Every clock strikes midnight, drowning the guard; Kenji laughs aloud
The guard leaves; relieved, Seraphina leads them calmly home

s01064.summary: On the crystal bridge, Queen Idrissa challenges the trespassing minstrel Finnegan
Idrissa and Balthazar declare that Finnegan's brother does not exist
Morgana strides from the fog and tells Balthazar to lower his staff
Morgana reveals she is the brother; Finnegan drops his lute

s01065.summary: In a leaky courtroom, the judge opens the eviction dispute
Marisela contradicts Dexter's claim the notice was posted
The judge reprimands Marisela to address the bench
Pratt charges Dexter with collecting rent without a stove
Marisela exposes the replacement stove as a hot plate
The judge calls enough as the bucket pings

s01066.summary: Three survivors camp by a raft on an ice floe
Bernadette radios Rescue One through garbled static
Bernadette announces rescue in two hours; Darius rallies
The floe splits; they leap into the raft as cracks open
They order the line cut; the raft slides free as the stove sinks
Rescue One comes through clear, saying they have them

s01067.summary: Abigail counts ice blocks while Tobias whittles; a stranger waits
The stranger asks for the master and says no one answered
Abigail questions him; he claims friendship with the departed Ashworths
He says he came for a sealed tin kept in the ice house
He reveals he is Rupert Ashworth, supposedly dead in the Punjab
Tobias, knife ready, urges Abigail behind him; she stands firm
Rupert wants only the tin and smiles tiredly as the door creaks

s01068.summary: Hour 487: Evelyn sways alone on the empty marathon floor
Jack rises from the shadows and shares his cigarette
Evelyn teases Jack for sleeping; he calls it pacing
Jack offers his hand and they dance off the beat
They joke about spending the prize on hats
They speak the same devotion in unison, then laugh softly
Evelyn asks him only to hold on, and he holds her
